name: bk_exp00_fve
title: The NLA reproduces its published reconstruction (FVE), and text-only explanations reconstruct far less
caption: Reconstruction (fraction of variance explained, FVE) of the NLA's critic rebuilding the layer-42 activation from a text, on 64 natural activations (k=4 samples each for the NLA, T=1, thinking off); bars are means, 95% bootstrap CIs over the 64 examples. The shipped reader reproduces the card (0.761 vs 0.766); a text model writing from the source text gets 0.28 and the source text itself 0.15 to 0.21. Caveat: the critic was co-trained on the NLA's register, so off-register text is handicapped; the fair text ceiling lies somewhere between 0.28 and the warm start's 0.46.

notes: reconstruction (FVE) = 1 - mean per-element MSE / per-element variance of the rescaled gold set (baseline 0.4616). The TextNLA row uses the warm-start instruction (experiments/06_resolving_decomposition/data/nla_instruction.txt), not the NLA actor prompt.
